items.titleZh: 原发性皮肤γ-δ T细胞淋巴瘤并发长期免疫抑制的皮肌炎
items.abstractZh: 原发性皮肤γ-δ T细胞淋巴瘤（PCGD-TCL）是一种罕见的细胞毒性淋巴瘤，其关键致癌驱动因子位于JAK/STAT通路。同样主要累及皮下脂肪组织的皮下脂膜炎样T细胞淋巴瘤（SPTCL）在自身免疫性疾病中更为常见。SPTCL与狼疮性脂膜炎有临床病理重叠。然而，自身免疫与PCGD-TCL之间的联系远未明确，尤其是在长期免疫抑制的皮肌炎（DM）背景下。我们报告了两例在慢性抗TIF1-γ DM女性患者中，经过多年免疫抑制治疗后出现的PCGD-TCL病例。病例1为47岁女性，有19年DM病史，接受硫唑嘌呤/泼尼松治疗，出现快速进展的疼痛性皮下结节。切开活检证实为TCR-δ+、CD8+细胞毒性T细胞淋巴增殖性疾病（TCLPD），符合PCGD-TCL。她在接受普拉曲沙及随后的异基因造血干细胞移植后达到完全缓解。病例2为27岁女性，DM患者，接受霉酚酸酯/利妥昔单抗治疗，出现皮下结节，病程惰性，部分自发消退。活检显示类似的脂膜炎样浸润，伴有非典型TCR-δ+、CD8+表型。值得注意的是，两例均未检测到高风险JAK/STAT通路突变。这些病例表明PCGD-TCLPD/TCL可能是慢性免疫抑制DM的潜在并发症。共有的非典型CD8+免疫表型和缺乏典型驱动突变提示可能存在与长期免疫调节相关的独特致病机制。与以侵袭性病程和<2年中位生存期为特征的经典PCGD-TCL不同，这两例的临床病程各异，一例需要移植，另一例表现为惰性行为并对治疗有反应。

items.title: Patients with Psoriatic Arthritis Have Increased Dental Comorbidities: A Nationwide Population-based Cohort Study in Korea.
items.abstract: Psoriatic arthritis is increasingly recognized as a systemic inflammatory disease with multiple comorbidities, yet the full spectrum of dental complications associated with psoriatic arthritis has not been clearly defined. This nationwide population based cohort study evaluated whether patients with psoriatic arthritis are at elevated risk of diverse dental diseases. Using a nationwide population-based health insurance database, we identified 40,920 newly diagnosed psoriatic arthritis cases and 204,468 age- and sex-matched controls. Dental outcomes included dental caries, pulp and periapical disease, periodontal disease, gingival changes and tooth loss. Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs). PsA patients exhibited significantly increased risks of dental caries (aHR 1.342), pulp and periapical disease (aHR 1.633) and periodontal disease (aHR 1.268). Subtype analyses revealed elevated risks for acute and chronic gingivitis, aggressive and chronic periodontitis, periodontosis and unspecified periodontal disease. These findings highlight the need for comprehensive oral health surveillance in patients with psoriatic arthritis.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎患者牙科合并症增加：韩国一项全国性基于人群的队列研究
items.abstractZh: 银屑病关节炎日益被认为是具有多种合并症的全身性炎症性疾病，但与其相关的牙科并发症的完整谱系尚未明确。这项全国性基于人群的队列研究评估了银屑病关节炎患者是否面临多种牙科疾病的更高风险。利用全国性基于人群的健康保险数据库，我们确定了40,920例新诊断的银屑病关节炎病例和204,468例年龄和性别匹配的对照者。牙科结局包括龋齿、牙髓和根尖周疾病、牙周疾病、牙龈改变和牙齿脱落。使用Cox比例风险模型估计调整后的风险比（aHRs）。银屑病关节炎患者表现出龋齿（aHR 1.342）、牙髓和根尖周疾病（aHR 1.633）以及牙周疾病（aHR 1.268）的风险显著增加。亚型分析显示，急性和慢性牙龈炎、侵袭性和慢性牙周炎、牙周变性及未特指牙周疾病的风险升高。这些发现强调了对银屑病关节炎患者进行综合口腔健康监测的必要性。

items.title: Metabolic exhaustion and immune ageing in rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) disproportionately affects adults over 50 years of age, highlighting how age-related immune remodelling undermines tolerance and promotes autoreactivity. In later adulthood, immune cells progressively lose metabolic resilience because of impaired nutrient sensing, reduced metabolic flexibility and disrupted anabolic-catabolic balance. In RA, these vulnerabilities are compounded by mitochondrial insufficiency across innate and adaptive immune lineages, creating a state of nutrient deprivation characterized by NAD⁺ and ATP scarcity and diversion of carbon away from oxidative phosphorylation. Mechanistic studies identify this bioenergetic fragility as a core defect that limits cellular longevity and promotes inflammatory, non-apoptotic death pathways, including pyroptosis and PANoptosis. The hypoxic, nutrient-restricted synovial environment adds pressure that exceeds the diminished metabolic adaptability of aged immune cells. In RA T cells, accelerated mitochondrial injury initiates maladaptive stress responses, disrupts mitochondria-lysosome-endoplasmic reticulum communication and induces gasdermin D-dependent pore formation and inflammatory lysis. Synovial MerTK⁺ reparative macrophages undergo a parallel metabolic crisis, whereby autocrine C1q sensing activates mitochondrial SARM1, causing NAD⁺ degradation, ATP depletion and PANoptotic cell death. Together, these findings position ageing-associated metabolic exhaustion and organelle disintegration as unifying mechanisms that convert immune cells into tissue-damaging effectors and explain the heightened susceptibility to RA in older adults.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中的代谢耗竭与免疫衰老
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）不成比例地影响50岁以上的成年人，凸显了年龄相关的免疫重塑如何破坏耐受性并促进自身反应性。在成年后期，由于营养感知受损、代谢灵活性降低以及合成代谢-分解代谢平衡紊乱，免疫细胞逐渐失去代谢弹性。在RA中，这些脆弱性因先天性和适应性免疫谱系中的线粒体功能不全而加剧，形成一种以NAD⁺和ATP缺乏以及碳从氧化磷酸化转移为特征的营养剥夺状态。机制研究确定这种生物能量脆弱性是限制细胞寿命并促进炎症性、非凋亡性死亡途径（包括焦亡和PANoptosis）的核心缺陷。缺氧、营养受限的滑膜环境增加了超出衰老免疫细胞减弱的代谢适应能力的压力。在RA T细胞中，加速的线粒体损伤引发适应不良的应激反应，破坏线粒体-溶酶体-内质网通讯，并诱导gasdermin D依赖性孔形成和炎症性裂解。滑膜MerTK⁺修复性巨噬细胞经历平行的代谢危机，其中自分泌C1q感知激活线粒体SARM1，导致NAD⁺降解、ATP耗竭和PANoptotic细胞死亡。总之，这些发现将衰老相关的代谢耗竭和细胞器崩解定位为将免疫细胞转化为组织损伤效应器的统一机制，并解释了老年人对RA易感性增加的原因。

items.title: Dapagliflozin in lupus nephritis: renal and hematologic outcomes from a randomized controlled trial.
items.abstract: Lupus nephritis (LN) remains a major cause of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and end-stage renal disease despite advances in immunosuppressive therapy. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors confer renal protection in diabetic and nondiabetic CKD and have been associated with increases in hemoglobin levels, but their renal and hematologic effects in immune-mediated glomerulopathies such as LN are not well defined. To evaluate the renal and hematologic effects, efficacy, and safety of dapagliflozin as adjunctive therapy in patients with LN. In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 79 adult patients with biopsy-proven LN and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) >30 ml/min/1.73 m 2 were randomized to receive dapagliflozin 10 mg/day ( n  = 38) or placebo ( n  = 41) for 12 months in addition to standard immunosuppressive therapy. The primary renal endpoint was percentage change in 24-h urinary protein excretion. Secondary renal outcomes included change in eGFR. Hematologic parameters assessed at baseline and 12 months included hemoglobin, erythropoietin, hepcidin, ferritin, and transferrin saturation. The primary analysis used analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) with adjustment for baseline values and clinically relevant covariates including age and background immunosuppressive therapy. Sensitivity analyses using log-transformed proteinuria were also performed. Additional analyses evaluated adjusted 12-month eGFR and eGFR slope. At 12 months, dapagliflozin was associated with a numerical reduction in proteinuria compared with placebo; however, this difference did not reach statistical significance. Adjusted analyses using ANCOVA confirmed the absence of a significant treatment effect. No significant differences were observed in eGFR, eGFR slope, or hematologic parameters. In this randomized controlled trial, dapagliflozin was associated with a numerical reduction in proteinuria that did not reach statistical significance after adjustment for baseline characteristics and background immunosuppressive therapy. No significant effect on kidney function, eGFR slope, or hematologic parameters was observed. These findings suggest a possible signal that requires confirmation in larger, adequately powered, longer-duration studies.Clinical trials registration number: NCT05748925 (ClinicalTrials.gov). Registered 28 February 2023-Retrospectively registered (https://register.clinicaltrials.gov/prs/beta/studies/S000CWI200000138/recordSummary).

items.titleZh: 达格列净治疗狼疮性肾炎：一项随机对照试验的肾脏和血液学结局
items.abstractZh: 尽管免疫抑制治疗取得了进展，狼疮性肾炎（LN）仍是慢性肾脏病（CKD）和终末期肾病的主要原因。钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂在糖尿病和非糖尿病CKD中具有肾脏保护作用，并与血红蛋白水平升高相关，但其在LN等免疫介导的肾小球疾病中的肾脏和血液学效应尚未明确。为评估达格列净作为LN患者辅助治疗的肾脏和血液学效应、疗效及安全性，本随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验将79例经活检证实为LN且估算肾小球滤过率（eGFR）>30 ml/min/1.73 m²的成年患者随机分配至达格列净10 mg/天（n=38）或安慰剂（n=41）组，治疗12个月，同时接受标准免疫抑制治疗。主要肾脏终点为24小时尿蛋白排泄的百分比变化。次要肾脏结局包括eGFR的变化。在基线和12个月时评估的血液学参数包括血红蛋白、促红细胞生成素、铁调素、铁蛋白和转铁蛋白饱和度。主要分析采用协方差分析（ANCOVA），调整基线值和临床相关协变量，包括年龄和背景免疫抑制治疗。还进行了使用对数转换蛋白尿的敏感性分析。额外分析评估了调整后的12个月eGFR和eGFR斜率。在12个月时，与安慰剂相比，达格列净与蛋白尿的数值性降低相关；然而，该差异未达到统计学显著性。使用ANCOVA的调整分析确认了无显著治疗效应。在eGFR、eGFR斜率或血液学参数方面未观察到显著差异。在本随机对照试验中，达格列净与蛋白尿的数值性降低相关，但在调整基线特征和背景免疫抑制治疗后未达到统计学显著性。未观察到对肾功能、eGFR斜率或血液学参数的显著影响。这些发现提示可能存在一个信号，需要在更大规模、充分把握度、更长持续时间的研究中加以确认。临床试验注册号：NCT05748925（ClinicalTrials.gov）。注册日期：2023年2月28日——回顾性注册（https://register.clinicaltrials.gov/prs/beta/studies/S000CWI200000138/recordSummary）。

items.title: Case Report: Overlapping multiple sclerosis and neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus with positive MOG-IgG: a case initially misdiagnosed as depression.
items.abstract: We present a 69-year-old female patient who initially manifested with depression and anhedonia, initially misdiagnosed as primary psychiatric illness. She subsequently developed progressive gait instability and cognitive decline. After comprehensive clinical and laboratory evaluation, she was finally diagnosed with multiple sclerosis (MS) complicated by neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus (NPSLE). Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed multifocal white matter lesions consistent with demyelination. Serologic testing demonstrated positivity for antinuclear antibody (ANA), anti-double-stranded DNA (dsDNA), anti-SS-A/Ro, anti-histone, anti-nucleosome, and anti-centromere antibodies. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) examination confirmed intrathecal synthesis of immunoglobulin G (IgG), as evidenced by CSF-restricted oligoclonal bands (OCBs). Serum myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein immunoglobulin G (MOG-IgG) was positive at a titer of 1:32, whereas aquaporin-4 (AQP4) antibodies were negative. Based on the clinical manifestations, laboratory results and disease progression, the final diagnosis was established as coexisting MS and NPSLE. The patient achieved clinical improvement after treatment with glucocorticoids and hydroxychloroquine. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges posed by overlapping autoimmune central nervous system (CNS) disorders and underscores the importance of longitudinal assessment in differentiating MS from MOG-IgG-associated disorder (MOGAD) and NPSLE.

items.titleZh: 病例报告：多发性硬化与伴MOG-IgG阳性的神经精神性系统性红斑狼疮重叠：一例最初被误诊为抑郁症的病例
items.abstractZh: 我们报告一例69岁女性患者，最初表现为抑郁和快感缺失，被误诊为原发性精神疾病。随后出现进行性步态不稳和认知功能下降。经过全面的临床和实验室评估，最终诊断为多发性硬化（MS）合并神经精神性系统性红斑狼疮（NPSLE）。头颅磁共振成像（MRI）显示多灶性白质病变，符合脱髓鞘改变。血清学检测显示抗核抗体（ANA）、抗双链DNA（dsDNA）、抗SS-A/Ro、抗组蛋白、抗核小体和抗着丝点抗体阳性。脑脊液（CSF）检查证实鞘内免疫球蛋白G（IgG）合成，表现为CSF-限制性寡克隆区带（OCBs）。血清髓鞘少突胶质细胞糖蛋白免疫球蛋白G（MOG-IgG）滴度为1:32阳性，而水通道蛋白-4（AQP4）抗体阴性。基于临床表现、实验室结果和疾病进展，最终诊断为MS与NPSLE共存。患者经糖皮质激素和羟氯喹治疗后获得临床改善。本病例强调了自身免疫性中枢神经系统（CNS）疾病重叠带来的诊断挑战，并强调了纵向评估在区分MS与MOG-IgG相关疾病（MOGAD）和NPSLE中的重要性。

items.title: CCR1-mediated monocyte chemotaxis in the immunopathology of primary Sjögren's syndrome: multi-omics integration analysis and computational target prioritization implicating Polygonatum odoratum .
items.abstract: Primary Sjögren's syndrome (pSS) is a chronic systemic autoimmune disease with no specific etiological treatment. Polygonatum odoratum , a traditional yin-nourishing herb, is used in treating pSS, but its molecular mechanism remains unclear. This study aimed to explore the potential association of CCR1 with pSS immunopathology and to computationally assess its candidacy as a predicted target of P. odoratum. Transcriptomic datasets (GSE51092, GSE66795; validation: GSE84844) and single-cell RNA sequencing data (GSE253568) were obtained from GEO. Network pharmacology screened active component targets of P. odoratum, and a "three-dimensional intersection" strategy identified candidate therapeutic targets. Single-cell analyses including monocyte subtyping, pseudotime trajectory, SCENIC transcription factor network, and CellChat cell communication analyses were performed. Molecular docking predicted drug-target binding, and RT-qPCR validated findings in clinical samples (pSS n = 65, HC n = 48). CCR1 was the only candidate target simultaneously satisfying "drug-targetable, disease-related, and differentially expressed" conditions. CCR1 was significantly upregulated in pSS patients (AUC = 0.758, indicating moderate discriminatory capacity) and positively correlated with serum IgG levels (R = 0.49, P = 0.0057). Single-cell analysis demonstrated CCR1 was specifically highly expressed in classical monocytes (CD14++CD16-), with CCR1-positive monocytes significantly expanded in pSS (P = 0.0079). SCENIC analysis predicted STAT1 and EGR1 as candidate upstream transcription factors potentially associated with CCR1 expression. CellChat analysis predicted a potential "T/NK cell-derived CCL5-CCR1-mediated monocyte chemotactic recruitment" signaling axis. Moupinamide from P. odoratum showed predicted binding affinity with CCR1 (-8.1 kcal/mol). RT-qPCR confirmed elevated CCR1 expression in pSS PBMCs (P < 0.0001). This study provides exploratory multi-dimensional evidence consistent with a candidate role of CCR1 in pSS immunopathology. CCR1 is predominantly expressed in classical monocytes, predicted to be associated with STAT1/EGR1 regulatory activity, and computationally linked to monocyte recruitment through the CCL5-CCR1 chemotactic axis. Pseudotime analysis suggested a computational inference of monocyte differentiation trajectory differences associated with CCR1 expression dynamics, requiring experimental validation. Moupinamide from P. odoratum shows predicted binding affinity to CCR1, offering a computational hypothesis for the "yin-nourishing and dryness-moistening" therapeutic principle that warrants experimental validation.

items.title: Immunological heterogeneity in rheumatoid arthritis: challenges in early-stage stratification, non-response to targeted therapy, and the restoration of immune tolerance.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a systemic autoimmune disease characterized by chronic erosive synovitis, progressive bone destruction, and marked inter-patient heterogeneity in disease course and treatment response. This review critically examines the mechanisms underlying RA immunological heterogeneity, including genetic susceptibility, epigenetic regulation, autoantibody diversification, synovial pathotypes, and gut-joint axis-related immune-metabolic interactions. We further discuss how peripheral blood multi-omics, synovial molecular pathology, and biopsy-driven clinical trial evidence may inform early stratification and prediction of primary non-response. Rather than proposing a deterministic precision-medicine model, this review emphasizes an evidence-weighted framework in which molecular and tissue-level biomarkers are integrated with clinical phenotype and longitudinal treatment response. Emerging approaches, including pharmacomicrobiomics, local drug delivery, nanomedicine, and cell-based therapies, are evaluated as investigational strategies that require further validation. Overall, this review highlights how a more critical understanding of RA heterogeneity may improve patient stratification and support more rational therapeutic selection.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎的免疫异质性：早期分层、靶向治疗无应答及免疫耐受恢复中的挑战
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种系统性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为慢性侵蚀性滑膜炎、进行性骨破坏，以及病程和治疗反应方面显著的患者间异质性。本综述批判性地探讨了RA免疫异质性背后的机制，包括遗传易感性、表观遗传调控、自身抗体多样化、滑膜病理类型以及肠-关节轴相关的免疫-代谢相互作用。我们进一步讨论了外周血多组学、滑膜分子病理学以及活检驱动的临床试验证据如何可能为早期分层和原发性无应答的预测提供信息。本综述并未提出一种确定性的精准医学模型，而是强调一种证据加权框架，在该框架中，分子和组织水平的生物标志物与临床表型及纵向治疗反应相结合。新兴方法，包括药物微生物组学、局部药物递送、纳米医学和细胞疗法，被评估为需要进一步验证的研究性策略。总体而言，本综述强调了更批判性地理解RA异质性如何可能改善患者分层并支持更合理的治疗选择。

items.title: Fibrotic remodeling in the NOD/ShiLtJ mouse model of Sjögren's disease: insights from single-cell transcriptomics and AI-driven ECM quantification.
items.abstract: Sjögren's Disease (SjD) is an autoimmune disorder characterized by salivary gland hypofunction and lymphocytic infiltration, yet the contribution of fibrosis to glandular dysfunction remains unclear. We evaluated the NOD/ShiLtJ mouse as a model for salivary gland fibrosis and used it to examine the impact of antifibrotic therapy on extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling. To assess therapeutic potential, we treated NOD/ShiLtJ female mice with nintedanib, an FDA-approved antifibrotic agent used to treat chronic fibrosing interstitial lung disease. Fibrosis was assessed using single-cell RNA sequencing combined with Picrosirius red staining and AI-assisted digital pathology quantification of collagen I patterning with FibroNest. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that fibroblast populations in the submandibular and sublingual salivary glands of the female NOD/ShiLtJ mouse exhibited increased levels of ECM genes, including Col1a1 , Col1a2 , and Col3a1 , relative to control mice. Consistent with these transcriptional changes, Picrosirius Red staining, combined with AI-assisted fibrosis quantification of collagen I patterns, demonstrated significant fibrotic remodeling in the periacinar ECM in submandibular glands of female NOD/ShiLtJ mice relative to controls. Notably, fibrosis severity strongly correlated with the diabetic phenotype characteristic of this strain, and both periductal and periacinar fibrosis progressed with age. An 8-week nintedanib treatment resulted in modest but measurable reductions across multiple fibrotic indices. Collectively, these findings establish the NOD/ShiLtJ strain as a model of SjD-associated salivary gland fibrosis and provide proof-of-concept evidence supporting antifibrotic strategies as a potential therapeutic avenue for salivary gland dysfunction in SjD.

items.title: Celastrol Ameliorates Systemic Lupus Erythematosus via Restoring Nt5e/ adenosine-dependent Th17/Treg Balance.
items.abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by the breakdown of immune tolerance, systemic inflammation, and multi-organ damage. The imbalance between T helper 17 (Th17) cells and regulatory T (Treg) cells is a key driver in SLE pathogenesis. This study aimed to investigate whether Celastrol (Cel), a natural triterpenoid derived from Tripterygium wilfordii, exerts therapeutic effects in SLE by modulating the Th17/Treg balance, and to explore the underlying molecular mechanism. An in vivo study using the MRL/lpr lupus-prone mouse model was conducted to evaluate therapeutic efficacy, complemented by in vitro assays and molecular analysis to identify target pathways. MRL/lpr mice were orally administered Cel and disease progression was assessed via survival analysis, spleen pathology, autoantibody levels, and renal histopathology. T cell subsets were analyzed using flow cytometry and Western blot. Proteomic profiling was performed to identify potential molecular targets, followed by molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), MicroScale Thermophoresis (MST) and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) to validate target engagement. AB680, a pharmacological inhibitor of ecto-5'-nucleotidase (Nt5e), was used to confirm the functional role of Nt5e. Cel treatment significantly improved survival, reduced splenomegaly, suppressed anti-dsDNA/ANA autoantibody levels, and alleviated renal damage in lupus-prone mice. It promoted Treg cell differentiation and inhibited Th17 polarization, evidenced by increased Foxp3 expression and decreased STAT3 phosphorylation. Nt5e was identified as a direct binding target of Cel. Target engagement was validated through CETSA, MST and SPR, and inhibition of Nt5e by AB680 partially reversed Cel's therapeutic effects, indicating that Nt5e mediates its immunomodulatory action. Our results indicate that Cel restores the Th17/Treg balance via upregulating Nt5e, thereby ameliorating SLE-associated injury. This study thus provides novel insights into the mechanism of Cel treating SLE and underscores the therapeutic potential of targeting Nt5e in SLE.

items.title: Two Cases of Eosinophilic Granulomatosis With Polyangiitis Presenting With Rhinologic Manifestations.
items.abstract: Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) frequently presents with asthma and sinusitis, making otorhinolaryngologic manifestations potential early indicators of systemic vasculitis. However, these manifestations are often misdiagnosed as common inflammatory diseases. We report two cases of EGPA diagnosed based on distinct rhinologic presentations. The first case involved a 52-year-old woman who developed mononeuritis multiplex and cutaneous vasculitis following surgery for nasal polyps, which ultimately led to a definitive diagnosis of EGPA. The second case involved a 39-year-old woman who presented with nasal septal perforation and was subsequently diagnosed with an acute exacerbation of EGPA accompanied by pulmonary infiltrates. These cases highlight that not only nasal polyps but also atypical findings, such as nasal septal perforation, may serve as critical diagnostic clues for EGPA. Otorhinolaryngologists play a pivotal role in identifying this potentially fatal systemic vasculitis through careful evaluation of localized sinonasal manifestations.

items.titleZh: 以鼻科表现为首发症状的嗜酸性肉芽肿性多血管炎两例
items.abstractZh: 嗜酸性肉芽肿性多血管炎（EGPA）常以哮喘和鼻窦炎为首发表现，使得耳鼻喉科表现可能成为系统性血管炎的早期指标。然而，这些表现常被误诊为常见的炎症性疾病。我们报告两例基于不同鼻科表现而确诊的EGPA病例。第一例为一名52岁女性，在鼻息肉手术后出现多发性单神经炎和皮肤血管炎，最终明确诊断为EGPA。第二例为一名39岁女性，表现为鼻中隔穿孔，随后被诊断为EGPA急性加重并伴有肺部浸润。这些病例强调，不仅鼻息肉，非典型表现如鼻中隔穿孔也可能成为EGPA的关键诊断线索。耳鼻喉科医生通过仔细评估局部鼻窦表现，在识别这种可能致命的系统性血管炎中发挥着关键作用。

items.title: Calcinosis of the Gastrocnemius Muscle in Juvenile Dermatomyositis: A Case Report of Successful Surgical Treatment.
items.abstract: Juvenile dermatomyositis is a rare pediatric inflammatory myopathy characterized by proximal muscle weakness and typical skin lesions. Although most patients achieve remission, up to 40% develop calcinosis, which may cause significant long-term morbidity. Management remains challenging, and surgical intervention is generally discouraged due to the risk of recurrence, ectopic ossification, and functional impairment. This case describes a 45-year-old man with a history of juvenile dermatomyositis in long-term remission who developed a spontaneous, painless swelling of the right calf. Imaging revealed extensive calcifications and soft tissue edema within the gastrocnemius muscle, initially interpreted as a hematoma in calcified tissue. After 2 months, the lesion became infected. Despite multiple debridements, antibiotics, and negative pressure wound therapy, the infection progressed and ultimately resulted in right-sided infective endocarditis. Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated that calcinosis was confined to the medial gastrocnemius. Given persistent infection and failure of conservative treatment, a multidisciplinary team performed complete surgical excision of the medial gastrocnemius and its calcified extension into the Achilles tendon. Postoperative recovery was uncomplicated, and the patient regained full function. At 1 year, imaging showed no recurrence of calcinosis and full integrity of the Achilles tendon. This Case Report demonstrates that, in selected cases, when calcinosis is confined to a single muscle, complete surgical excision can provide a definitive cure, restore function, and prevent recurrence.

items.titleZh: 青少年皮肌炎腓肠肌钙质沉着症：一例成功手术治疗报告
items.abstractZh: 青少年皮肌炎是一种罕见的儿童炎症性肌病，以近端肌无力和典型皮肤病变为特征。尽管大多数患者达到缓解，但高达40%的患者出现钙质沉着，可能导致显著的长期发病率。治疗仍具挑战性，且由于复发、异位骨化和功能损害的风险，通常不鼓励手术干预。本病例描述一名45岁男性，有长期缓解的青少年皮肌炎病史，出现右小腿自发性无痛性肿胀。影像学显示腓肠肌内广泛钙化和软组织水肿，最初被解释为钙化组织中的血肿。2个月后，病灶发生感染。尽管多次清创、使用抗生素和负压伤口治疗，感染仍进展，最终导致右侧感染性心内膜炎。磁共振成像显示钙质沉着局限于内侧腓肠肌。鉴于持续感染和保守治疗失败，多学科团队对内侧腓肠肌及其延伸至跟腱的钙化部分进行了完全手术切除。术后恢复顺利，患者完全恢复功能。1年时，影像学显示无钙质沉着复发，跟腱完整性良好。本病例报告表明，在特定病例中，当钙质沉着局限于单一肌肉时，完全手术切除可提供根治性治愈、恢复功能并预防复发。

items.title: Subcutaneous golimumab in the treatment of Juvenile idiopathic arthritis-associated anterior uveitis after failing other tumor necrosis factor alpha inhibitors.
items.abstract: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of subcutaneous (SQ) golimumab (GLM) in patients with juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA)-associated anterior uveitis who failed prior tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α) inhibitors. This retrospective case series included 16 eyes from 8 patients with JIA associated anterior uveitis who had previously failed at least one TNF-α inhibitor. Data collected included demographics, previous treatments, best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA), and uveitis severity. Assessments were made at baseline, and at 3, 6, and 12 months following SQ GLM initiation. Eight patients (87.5% female, all white) with an average age of 18.6 years were included. Uveitis was bilateral and chronic in all cases. Five patients (62.5%) achieved remission after SQ GLM. The average logarithm of the minimum angle of resolution improved significantly from 0.11 at baseline before starting treatment to 0.03 at 12 months after starting treatment ( P = 0.006). No cystoid macular edema developed during the follow-up. SQ GLM was discontinued in three patients due to ineffectiveness and/or other reasons. No significant correlations were found between response to SQ GLM and clinical variables. No adverse effects were observed during the study period. SQ GLM shows promise in treating JIA associated anterior uveitis, especially in cases without severe complications. Significant improvement in BCVA and inflammation control suggests its potential as a treatment option, although further studies with larger populations are needed to confirm these findings.

items.titleZh: 皮下注射戈利木单抗治疗对其他肿瘤坏死因子α抑制剂无效的幼年特发性关节炎相关前葡萄膜炎
items.abstractZh: 旨在评估皮下注射（SQ）戈利木单抗（GLM）对既往使用肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）抑制剂失败的幼年特发性关节炎（JIA）相关前葡萄膜炎患者的疗效和安全性。本回顾性病例系列研究纳入8例JIA相关前葡萄膜炎患者的16只眼，这些患者既往至少对一种TNF-α抑制剂治疗失败。收集的数据包括人口统计学特征、既往治疗、最佳矫正视力（BCVA）和葡萄膜炎严重程度。在基线以及SQ GLM开始后3、6和12个月进行评估。共纳入8例患者（87.5%为女性，均为白人），平均年龄18.6岁。所有病例均为双侧慢性葡萄膜炎。5例患者（62.5%）在SQ GLM治疗后达到缓解。最小分辨角对数平均值从治疗开始前基线的0.11显著改善至治疗开始后12个月的0.03（P = 0.006）。随访期间未发生黄斑囊样水肿。3例患者因疗效不佳和/或其他原因停用SQ GLM。SQ GLM应答与临床变量之间未发现显著相关性。研究期间未观察到不良事件。SQ GLM在治疗JIA相关前葡萄膜炎方面显示出前景，尤其是在无严重并发症的病例中。BCVA的显著改善和炎症控制提示其作为治疗选择的潜力，但仍需更大样本量的进一步研究来证实这些发现。

items.title: Autoantibody-Based Models for the Diagnosis and Activity Assessment of Takayasu Arteritis.
items.abstract: The precise diagnosis and activity assessment of Takayasu arteritis (TA) remain challenging. Using a two-phase approach, we screened serum from 9 TA patients and 10 healthy controls via HuProt microarrays, identifying three novel autoantibodies (anti-Table 2, anti-TRAC, anti-LILRA5). These were validated by ELISA in 175 samples (61 active TA, 42 inactive TA, 72 controls). Logistic regression models were developed from training (70%) and test (30%) sets. For diagnosis, Model 1 achieved AUCs of 0.88 and 0.86, outperforming CRP (0.58) and ESR (0.61). For activity assessment, Model 2 achieved AUCs of 0.78 and 0.79, superior to CRP (0.62) and ESR (0.58). These novel autoantibody-based models enable accurate, non-invasive diagnosis and activity assessment in TA.

items.titleZh: 基于自身抗体的模型用于大动脉炎的诊断和活动性评估。
items.abstractZh: 大动脉炎（TA）的精确诊断和活动性评估仍具挑战性。采用两阶段方法，我们通过HuProt微阵列筛选了9名TA患者和10名健康对照者的血清，鉴定出三种新型自身抗体（抗Table 2、抗TRAC、抗LILRA5）。这些抗体通过ELISA在175份样本（61例活动性TA、42例非活动性TA、72例对照）中得到验证。逻辑回归模型基于训练集（70%）和测试集（30%）开发。对于诊断，模型1的AUC分别为0.88和0.86，优于CRP（0.58）和ESR（0.61）。对于活动性评估，模型2的AUC分别为0.78和0.79，优于CRP（0.62）和ESR（0.58）。这些新型自身抗体模型能够实现TA的准确、无创诊断和活动性评估。

items.title: Peripheral blood CD19+B cell proportion at baseline predicts early complete response to belimumab treatment in patients with refractory lupus nephritis.
items.abstract: Belimumab has been proven to be effective for treating refractory lupus nephritis. However, the meaningful renal response is still far from satisfactory. This study sought to identify immunological biomarkers to stratify patients who are likely to benefit from belimumab therapy. We retrospectively reviewed the medical records of patients with refractory lupus nephritis who received 6 months belimumab treatment. Complete response (CR), partial response (PR) and no response (NR) were evaluated, and the predictors of CR were identified. A total of 28 patients with refractory LN were enrolled. The proportions of CR, PR and NR at 6 months were 39.29%, 32.14% and 28.57%, respectively. The baseline CD19+B cell proportions were significantly higher in CR patients than those in non-CR patients (19.30% vs 10.72%, p<0.001). In the binary logistic regression, baseline CD19+B cell proportion was identified as a predictor of CR in both univariate analysis (OR 1.359, 95% CI 1.098 to 1.683, p=0.005) and exploratory multivariate analysis adjusting for 24-hour urinary protein (OR 1.349, 95% CI 1.092 to 1.665, p=0.005). Receiver operating characteristic showed that the cut-off level of CD19+B cell proportion was 15.12%, with a sensitivity of 90.90%, specificity of 88.20% and an area under curve of 0.888 (95% CI 0.759 to 1.000, p=0.001). Findings support the baseline CD19+B cell proportion could be used to predict CR to treatment with belimumab in refractory lupus nephritis patients.

items.titleZh: 基线外周血CD19+B细胞比例可预测难治性狼疮肾炎患者对贝利木单抗治疗的早期完全缓解
items.abstractZh: 贝利木单抗已被证明对治疗难治性狼疮肾炎有效。然而，有意义的肾脏反应仍远未令人满意。本研究旨在识别免疫学生物标志物，以筛选可能从贝利木单抗治疗中获益的患者。我们回顾性审查了接受6个月贝利木单抗治疗的难治性狼疮肾炎患者的医疗记录。评估了完全缓解（CR）、部分缓解（PR）和无缓解（NR），并确定了CR的预测因素。共纳入28例难治性LN患者。6个月时CR、PR和NR的比例分别为39.29%、32.14%和28.57%。CR患者的基线CD19+B细胞比例显著高于非CR患者（19.30% vs 10.72%，p<0.001）。在二元逻辑回归中，基线CD19+B细胞比例在单变量分析（OR 1.359，95% CI 1.098至1.683，p=0.005）和调整24小时尿蛋白的探索性多变量分析（OR 1.349，95% CI 1.092至1.665，p=0.005）中均被确定为CR的预测因素。受试者工作特征曲线显示，CD19+B细胞比例的截断值为15.12%，敏感性为90.90%，特异性为88.20%，曲线下面积为0.888（95% CI 0.759至1.000，p=0.001）。研究结果支持基线CD19+B细胞比例可用于预测难治性狼疮肾炎患者对贝利木单抗治疗的CR。

items.title: Distinguishing true from false idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: Progress in biomarkers for early identification of rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: Patients initially diagnosed with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) have an underlying risk of being in a preclinical phase of rheumatoid arthritis (RA), but effective biomarkers for early identification of this transition are lacking. This review aims to comprehensively summarize predictive markers for future RA in patients meeting IPF diagnostic criteria, supporting early risk stratification and pre-arthritic intervention. Using "idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis", "rheumatoid arthritis", "predictive markers", "markers", "clinical research", "in vitro experiments", "mechanism", and their combinations as keywords, a structured literature search was conducted in the PubMed database for relevant literature from 2001 to 2025. The propensity for RA to develop in patients initially meeting IPF diagnostic criteria has a multi-dimensional basis: genetic susceptibility provides the background; immune dysregulation mediates the dissemination of autoimmunity from a pulmonary origin to systemic involvement; inflammatory markers reflect disease activity; environmental exposure acts as an external trigger. Based on these mechanisms, four predictive marker types were identified: genetic susceptibility, immune activation, inflammatory injury, and environmental exposure. However, current studies are mainly cross-sectional and retrospective, lacking prospective validation of predictive efficacy; combined application strategies, clinical value and microbiome-based indicators all require further clinical verification. This review identified four early-warning markers-genetic susceptibility, immune activation, inflammatory injury, and environmental exposure-that may signal future RA in patients initially presenting with IPF. These findings support shifting from passive diagnosis to active screening for earlier intervention. Future research should focus on multi-dimensional prediction models, prospective cohort studies, and ultimately achieving early identification and intervention for this hidden RA-prone population.

items.title: Impact of BMI on response to Janus kinase inhibitors in rheumatoid arthritis: an individual patient data meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials.
items.abstract: Obesity is common in patients with rheumatoid arthritis and is associated with poorer disease outcomes. We aimed to evaluate the association between BMI and clinical response to Januse kinase (JAK) inhibitors in patients with rheumatoid arthritis using individual patient data from the JAK inhibitor randomised controlled trial programmes. In this individual patient data meta-analysis, ClinicalTrials.gov was searched from database inception to Jan 13, 2025, for phase 3, randomised controlled trials of tofacitinib, baricitinib, upadacitinib, and filgotinib in adult patients with rheumatoid arthritis, with a placebo or active comparator. Individual patient data were obtained via the Vivli data-sharing platform. The primary outcomes were a 20% improvement based on American College of Rheumatology (ACR) core set variables (ACR20) and Disease Activity Score based on the evaluation of 28 joints and C-reactive protein (DAS28-CRP), at the trial-defined primary efficacy timepoint. BMI was analysed as a continuous and categorical variable using one-stage mixed-effects models, and validated using a two-stage individual patient data meta-analysis. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool. There was no involvement of people with lived experience in the study design or conduct. This study is registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251180005). 16 trials contributed individual patient data from 11 883 participants (9588 [80·7%] women and 2293 [19·3%] men, and two with missing sex data). Mean age was 52·9 years (SD 12·3). 8493 (71·5%) of 11 883 participants were White, 2142 (18·0%) were Asian, 439 (3·7%) were Black, and 809 (6·8%) were of other ethnicity. 7765 received tofacitinib, upadacitinib, or baricitinib. Filgotinib trials were excluded due to insufficient variables. Median BMI was 26·8 kg/m 2 (IQR 23·2-31·3) and 3676 (30·9%) patients had class 1-3 obesity. Higher BMI was associated with reduced JAK inhibitor efficacy across all endpoints. Compared with patients with healthy weight, adjusted relative risk for ACR20 response was 0·94 (95% CI 0·91-0·98) for patients with overweight (25 to <30 kg/m 2 ), 0·92 (0·89-0·96) for class 1 obesity (30 to <35 kg/m 2 ), 0·88 (0·81-0·96) for class 2 obesity (35 to <40 kg/m 2 ), and 0·78 (0·71-0·85) for class 3 obesity (≥40 kg/m 2 ). For DAS28-CRP, adjusted mean differences compared with healthy weight were 0·14 (95% CI 0·06-0·22) for overweight, 0·21 (0·12-0·31) for class 1 obesity, 0·30 (0·16-0·44) for class 2 obesity, and 0·54 (0·37-0·70) for class 3 obesity. No corresponding BMI gradient was observed in the placebo group. Between-study heterogeneity was low to moderate (I 2 =0-40%). Overall risk of bias in individual studies was low. Higher BMI was associated with poorer response and a reduced treatment benefit with JAK inhibitors, with obesity acting as an effect modifier. These findings support integration of weight management into routine care for rheumatoid arthritis and improved BMI representation in future trials. None.

items.titleZh: BMI对类风湿关节炎患者Janus激酶抑制剂应答的影响：随机对照试验的个体患者数据荟萃分析
items.abstractZh: 肥胖在类风湿关节炎患者中常见，且与较差的疾病结局相关。我们旨在利用JAK抑制剂随机对照试验项目中的个体患者数据，评估BMI与类风湿关节炎患者对Janus激酶（JAK）抑制剂临床应答之间的关联。在这项个体患者数据荟萃分析中，从数据库建立至2025年1月13日检索了ClinicalTrials.gov，纳入托法替布、巴瑞替尼、乌帕替尼和菲戈替尼在成年类风湿关节炎患者中进行的3期随机对照试验，并设有安慰剂或活性对照。个体患者数据通过Vivli数据共享平台获取。主要结局为基于美国风湿病学会（ACR）核心集变量的20%改善（ACR20）以及基于28个关节评估和C反应蛋白的疾病活动评分（DAS28-CRP），在试验定义的主要疗效时间点进行评估。BMI作为连续变量和分类变量，使用单阶段混合效应模型进行分析，并通过两阶段个体患者数据荟萃分析进行验证。使用Cochrane偏倚风险2工具评估偏倚风险。研究设计或实施中未涉及有生活经验者的参与。本研究已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420251180005）。16项试验提供了来自11883名参与者的个体患者数据（9588名[80.7%]女性，2293名[19.3%]男性，另有2名性别数据缺失）。平均年龄为52.9岁（SD 12.3）。11883名参与者中8493名（71.5%）为白人，2142名（18.0%）为亚洲人，439名（3.7%）为黑人，809名（6.8%）为其他族裔。7765名接受了托法替布、乌帕替尼或巴瑞替尼。菲戈替尼试验因变量不足被排除。BMI中位数为26.8 kg/m²（IQR 23.2-31.3），3676名（30.9%）患者患有1-3级肥胖。较高的BMI与所有终点上JAK抑制剂疗效降低相关。与健康体重患者相比，超重（25至<30 kg/m²）患者ACR20应答的调整后相对风险为0.94（95% CI 0.91-0.98），1级肥胖（30至<35 kg/m²）为0.92（0.89-0.96），2级肥胖（35至<40 kg/m²）为0.88（0.81-0.96），3级肥胖（≥40 kg/m²）为0.78（0.71-0.85）。对于DAS28-CRP，与健康体重相比，调整后平均差异为超重0.14（95% CI 0.06-0.22），1级肥胖0.21（0.12-0.31），2级肥胖0.30（0.16-0.44），3级肥胖0.54（0.37-0.70）。在安慰剂组中未观察到相应的BMI梯度。研究间异质性为低至中度（I²=0-40%）。各项研究的总体偏倚风险较低。较高的BMI与较差的应答和JAK抑制剂治疗获益减少相关，肥胖作为效应修饰因子。这些发现支持将体重管理纳入类风湿关节炎的常规护理，并在未来试验中改善BMI的代表性。无。

items.title: Urban heat island and risk of rheumatoid arthritis: Insights from genetic predisposition and proteomics.
items.abstract: Urban heat island (UHI) exposure is an increasingly common consequence of urbanization and climate warming, but its association with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) risk remains unclear. To investigate the association between UHI exposure and incident RA, and to further assess the roles of genetic susceptibility and plasma proteomic profiles in this association. This study included 400,628 urban residents with UHI exposure data and free of RA at baseline. Cox proportional hazards models were used to evaluate the association between UHI exposure and incident RA. Polygenic risk scores were used to assess effect modification by genetic susceptibility. Proteomic analyses identified candidate proteins and enriched pathways underlying the association. Mendelian randomization, colocalization, and mediation analyses assessed causal relevance and mediation. Over a median follow-up of 14.05 years, 5397 incident RA cases were documented. Each standard-deviation increase in UHI exposure was associated with a 17% higher risk of RA. This association was more pronounced among older adults and individuals with lower socioeconomic status. An additive interaction was observed between UHI exposure and genetic risk for RA. Proteomic analyses suggested that this association may involve not only canonical immune-inflammatory pathways, but also hypoxia response and protein transport, with CD40, VCAM1, and SUGP1 emerging as potential molecular mediators. UHI exposure may be a modifiable environmental risk factor for RA and provide new insights into the biological mechanisms underlying this association.

items.titleZh: 城市热岛效应与类风湿关节炎风险：来自遗传易感性和蛋白质组学的见解
items.abstractZh: 城市热岛（UHI）暴露是城市化和气候变暖日益常见的后果，但其与类风湿关节炎（RA）风险的关联仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨UHI暴露与RA发病之间的关联，并进一步评估遗传易感性和血浆蛋白质组学特征在该关联中的作用。本研究纳入了400,628名具有UHI暴露数据且基线时无RA的城市居民。使用Cox比例风险模型评估UHI暴露与RA发病之间的关联。使用多基因风险评分评估遗传易感性的效应修饰。蛋白质组学分析确定了与该关联相关的候选蛋白和富集通路。孟德尔随机化、共定位和中介分析评估了因果相关性和中介作用。在中位随访14.05年期间，记录了5,397例新发RA病例。UHI暴露每增加一个标准差，RA风险增加17%。这种关联在老年人和社会经济地位较低的个体中更为显著。观察到UHI暴露与RA遗传风险之间存在加性交互作用。蛋白质组学分析提示，这种关联可能不仅涉及经典的免疫炎症通路，还涉及缺氧反应和蛋白质转运，其中CD40、VCAM1和SUGP1作为潜在的分子中介因子。UHI暴露可能是RA的一个可改变的环境危险因素，并为该关联的生物学机制提供新的见解。

items.title: Clinical phenotypes and etiologic subtypes of thrombotic microangiopathy in systemic lupus erythematosus.
items.abstract: Thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA) is a rare and severe complication of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). While classically defined by microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and organ damage, TMA may also present as a renal-limited process requiring histologic diagnosis. Data characterizing the clinical phenotypes, histologic patterns, etiologic subtypes, and outcomes of SLE-associated TMA remain limited. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of adults with SLE-TMA diagnosed between 2004 and 2024 at a tertiary referral center. TMA was defined by either hematologic criteria and/or kidney biopsy findings. Patients were categorized as having renal-hematologic TMA (RH-TMA) or renal-limited TMA (RL-TMA). Etiologic adjudication was performed using predefined clinical criteria, incorporating validated probability scores and serologic evaluation. Clinical characteristics, histologic findings, treatment, and long-term outcomes were analyzed by survival analyses. A total of 124 patients were included. The median age was 29 years and 90% were female. Kidney biopsy was performed in 81% of cases. Nearly half of cases (48%) presented as RL-TMA without hematologic manifestations. Compared with RH-TMA, RL-TMA was associated with a higher prevalence of chronic vascular lesions (aOR 2.84, 95%CI 1.04-7.78) and an increased risk of renal relapse (aHR 2.67, 95%CI 1.17-6.09), while mortality was higher in RH-TMA. Histologic activity pattern (acute vs. chronic lesions) was not associated with renal outcomes. Etiologic adjudication suggested three predominant phenotypes: suspected complement-mediated TMA (59.7%), antiphospholipid syndrome nephropathy (34.7%), and TTP-like TMA (5.6%). Patients with TTP-like presentations had more severe hematologic involvement but favorable renal recovery among survivors. SLE-associated TMA frequently presents as a renal-limited syndrome requiring biopsy for diagnosis. A phenotype-based approach identifies clinically relevant subgroups with distinct renal trajectories, even in the absence of systematic biomarker confirmation. These findings support a pragmatic diagnostic framework for SLE-TMA and highlight the importance of kidney biopsy in patients without overt hematologic features.

items.title: Independent association and discriminative performance of the timed up and go test for disease activity and functional status in ankylosing spondylitis.
items.abstract: To determine whether Timed Up and Go (TUG) performance is independently associated with patient-reported disease activity and functional status in AS and to assess its ability to identify unacceptable symptom states defined by patient acceptable symptom state (PASS) thresholds. In this cross-sectional study, 108 AS patients were included. Disease activity and functional status were assessed using the Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI) and Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Functional Index (BASFI). Functional mobility was evaluated with the TUG test. Unacceptable symptom state was defined using established PASS thresholds (BASDAI ≥ 4.1; BASFI ≥ 3.8). Associations were examined using Pearson/Spearman correlations and multivariable linear regression adjusting for age, sex, and body mass index. Discriminative performance of TUG was evaluated using ROC analyses. Mean TUG time was 9.12 ± 1.76 s, with BASDAI and BASFI values of 4.19 ± 1.99 and 3.16 ± 2.23. TUG was significantly correlated with BASDAI (r = 0.444, p < 0.001) and BASFI (r = 0.562, p < 0.001). In adjusted models, each 1-s increase in TUG was independently associated with higher BASDAI (0.533 points, 95% CI 0.341-0.726; p < 0.001) and BASFI (0.670 points, 95% CI 0.456-0.884; p < 0.001). ROC analyses showed moderate discrimination for BASDAI-based unacceptable symptom state (AUC = 0.760, 95% CI 0.668-0.852) and good discrimination for BASFI-based unacceptable symptom state (AUC = 0.800, 95% CI 0.714-0.887). Optimal cut-off values were 9.07 s for BASDAI and 9.51 s for BASFI. In an exploratory combined analysis, TUG also discriminated the simultaneous presence of BASDAI- and BASFI-defined unacceptable symptom states (AUC = 0.794, 95% CI 0.703-0.884). TUG shows independent associations with disease activity and functional status in AS and provides meaningful discrimination for identifying unacceptable symptom states defined by PASS thresholds, with stronger discrimination for functional impairment. Key Points • The Timed Up and Go (TUG) test was independently associated with both disease activity (BASDAI) and functional status (BASFI) in ankylosing spondylitis. • TUG showed moderate-to-good discriminative performance for identifying PASS-defined unacceptable symptom states based on BASDAI, BASFI, and their concurrent presence (AUC = 0.760, 0.800, and 0.794, respectively). • TUG cut-off values of 9.07 s, 9.51 s, and 9.59 s may help identify patients with unacceptable disease activity, functional status, and concurrent unacceptable symptom states, respectively. • This study evaluates the independent associations and PASS-based discriminative performance of the Timed Up and Go test in ankylosing spondylitis using correlation, multivariable regression, and ROC analyses.

items.title: Radiomics analysis and classification of esophageal involvement in systemic sclerosis using chest CT images.
items.abstract: Esophageal involvement is a common and early manifestation of systemic sclerosis (SSc). This involvement is mainly evaluated by esophageal manometry, but this test is invasive and provides limited morphological information. This study aimed to identify CT-based radiomics features related to esophageal involvement and to evaluate whether the presence or absence of esophageal involvement can be classified with high accuracy. Chest CT images from 64 subjects were analyzed, including 30 patients with SSc and 34 normal subjects. The esophageal region was automatically segmented, and radiomics features were extracted from ellipse-fitted regions of interest on axial slices. Features showing significant differences were selected, and feature combinations were evaluated using exhaustive search. Classification was performed using XGBoost. First-order statistical features at levels corresponding to the third to fifth thoracic vertebrae were significantly associated with the presence of esophageal involvement. Classification using these features showed high accuracy when five to six features were used, indicating that the presence or absence of esophageal involvement can be identified accurately even with a small number of features. CT-based radiomics analysis may be a useful noninvasive method for evaluating esophageal involvement. Future studies incorporating pathological correlation and surrounding tissue information may further improve clinical applicability.

items.title: Optimizing Hydroxychloroquine Blood Levels and Long-Term Hydroxychloroquine Intake Could Lower ASCVD Risk and Prevent Polypharmacy in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
items.abstract: Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) is the cornerstone of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) management with benefits extending beyond SLE control, including protection against atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). While HCQ blood levels reflect recent exposure and long-term intake reflects medication adherence, the impact of longitudinal changes in both measures on ASCVD risk over time remains unclear. We evaluated how HCQ blood levels and long-term intake patterns relate to estimated ASCVD risk at baseline and after one year. In this prospective longitudinal study, 248 adults with SLE from the Wisconsin cohort (meeting 2019 ACR/EULAR criteria) taking HCQ and completing baseline and 1-year follow-up visits were included. Long-term HCQ intake was estimated using the proportion of days covered (PDC), and whole-blood HCQ levels served as a marker of recent exposure. Ten-year ASCVD risk was calculated at both time points using the PREVENT calculator. Multivariable linear regression assessed associations between HCQ exposure patterns and ASCVD risk. Changes in exposure categories over one year were also evaluated. Patients with very low HCQ blood levels (<200 ng/mL) and low long-term intake (PDC <80%) had significantly higher ASCVD risk at baseline (+2.1%) with a mean predicted risk of 6.6%. Those who remained in or transitioned into these low-exposure categories over one year had the highest ASCVD risk at follow-up (5.7%). Maintaining low long-term HCQ intake and very low HCQ blood levels increased ASCVD risk in patients with SLE. Interventions promoting sustained adherence and therapeutic HCQ levels may enhance cardiovascular outcomes and reduce unnecessary preventive therapies.

items.abstractZh: 羟氯喹（HCQ）是系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）管理的基石，其益处不仅限于控制SLE，还包括预防动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）。虽然HCQ血药浓度反映近期暴露，长期摄入反映用药依从性，但这两项指标随时间纵向变化对ASCVD风险的影响仍不清楚。我们评估了HCQ血药浓度和长期摄入模式与基线和一年后估计ASCVD风险的关系。在这项前瞻性纵向研究中，纳入了来自威斯康星队列的248名成人SLE患者（符合2019年ACR/EULAR标准），他们服用HCQ并完成了基线和1年随访。长期HCQ摄入通过药物覆盖天数比例（PDC）估算，全血HCQ水平作为近期暴露的标志。使用PREVENT计算器在两个时间点计算10年ASCVD风险。多变量线性回归评估了HCQ暴露模式与ASCVD风险之间的关联。还评估了一年期间暴露类别的变化。HCQ血药浓度极低（<200 ng/mL）且长期摄入低（PDC <80%）的患者在基线时ASCVD风险显著更高（+2.1%），平均预测风险为6.6%。一年内保持或转入这些低暴露类别的患者在随访时ASCVD风险最高（5.7%）。维持低长期HCQ摄入和极低HCQ血药浓度会增加SLE患者的ASCVD风险。促进持续依从性和治疗性HCQ水平的干预措施可能改善心血管结局并减少不必要的预防性治疗。

items.title: Longitudinal Course of Muscle Status in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis.
items.abstract: Muscle impairment is a common complication of rheumatoid arthritis (RA), but longitudinal data regarding its clinical course remain limited. This study aimed to evaluate the prevalence of muscle impairment and longitudinal changes in muscle status in patients with RA and to identify factors associated with muscle impairment. This retrospective cohort study included 75 patients with RA who underwent assessment of skeletal muscle mass index (SMI) using bioelectrical impedance analysis and handgrip strength at baseline and follow-up. Muscle status was classified according to the Asian Working Group for Sarcopenia 2025 criteria using handgrip strength and height-adjusted SMI as normal muscle status, low muscle mass, possible sarcopenia, or sarcopenia. Patients with low muscle mass, possible sarcopenia, or sarcopenia were categorized as having muscle impairment. Baseline characteristics associated with muscle impairment were evaluated using logistic regression analysis. Longitudinal changes in SMI, handgrip strength, and muscle status were assessed over a median follow-up of 29 months. At baseline, 20 patients (26.7%) had normal muscle status, whereas 55 (73.3%) had muscle impairment, including 30 (40.0%) with sarcopenia. Patients with muscle impairment were older and had lower body mass index (BMI), more advanced Steinbrocker stage, worse physical function, and lower health-related quality of life than those with normal muscle status. In multivariable logistic regression analysis, older age (odds ratio [OR] 1.10, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.03-1.20, p = 0.009) and lower BMI (OR 0.79, 95% CI 0.65-0.92, p = 0.005) were independently associated with muscle impairment. No significant changes in SMI or handgrip strength were observed during follow-up. Among patients with normal muscle status at baseline, 78% remained normal at follow-up, whereas 86% of those with muscle impairment continued to exhibit impaired muscle status. Muscle impairment was highly prevalent in patients with RA and was independently associated with older age and lower BMI. No significant longitudinal changes in muscle status were detected during follow-up, with most patients retaining their baseline muscle status classification. These findings provide longitudinal evidence that muscle impairment tends to persist in patients with established RA.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎患者肌肉状态的纵向变化过程
items.abstractZh: 肌肉损伤是类风湿关节炎（RA）的常见并发症，但关于其临床过程的纵向数据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估RA患者肌肉损伤的患病率及肌肉状态的纵向变化，并确定与肌肉损伤相关的因素。这项回顾性队列研究纳入了75例RA患者，他们在基线和随访时接受了生物电阻抗分析评估骨骼肌质量指数（SMI）和握力测量。根据亚洲肌少症工作组2025年标准，使用握力和身高调整后的SMI将肌肉状态分类为正常肌肉状态、低肌肉质量、可能肌少症或肌少症。低肌肉质量、可能肌少症或肌少症的患者被归类为具有肌肉损伤。使用逻辑回归分析评估与肌肉损伤相关的基线特征。在中位随访29个月期间评估了SMI、握力和肌肉状态的纵向变化。基线时，20例患者（26.7%）肌肉状态正常，而55例（73.3%）存在肌肉损伤，其中30例（40.0%）患有肌少症。与肌肉状态正常的患者相比，肌肉损伤患者年龄更大，体重指数（BMI）更低，Steinbrocker分期更晚期，身体功能更差，健康相关生活质量更低。在多变量逻辑回归分析中，年龄较大（比值比[OR] 1.10，95%置信区间[CI] 1.03-1.20，p = 0.009）和BMI较低（OR 0.79，95% CI 0.65-0.92，p = 0.005）与肌肉损伤独立相关。随访期间未观察到SMI或握力的显著变化。基线时肌肉状态正常的患者中，78%在随访时保持正常，而肌肉损伤患者中86%继续表现出肌肉状态受损。肌肉损伤在RA患者中非常普遍，并与年龄较大和BMI较低独立相关。随访期间未检测到肌肉状态的显著纵向变化，大多数患者保持其基线肌肉状态分类。这些发现提供了纵向证据，表明肌肉损伤在已确诊的RA患者中倾向于持续存在。

items.title: Therapeutic management of axial spondyloarthritis: summary of 2024 update of the Spanish clinical practice guideline (ESPOGUIA).
items.abstract: Axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) is a chronic inflammatory rheumatic disease associated with significant morbidity and impaired quality of life. Rapid advances in diagnosis, monitoring, and especially treatment over the past decade have increased the complexity of axSpA management and contributed to variability in clinical practice. To address this need, the Spanish Society of Rheumatology (SER) has developed an updated version of ESPOGUÍA, its clinical practice guideline for spondyloarthritis. This review summarizes the updated recommendations. A multidisciplinary panel (including rheumatologists, other medical specialists, nurses, physiotherapists, methodologists, and patients) formulated key clinical questions using the PICO framework. Systematic literature reviews covering the period 2018-2023 were conducted across major databases. Evidence quality and strength of recommendations were assessed using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) methodology. When evidence was insufficient, recommendations were formulated through a structured deliberative consensus process using the GRADE Evidence-to-Decision framework. Patient representatives actively contributed throughout the process, and the draft guideline underwent public consultation. ESPOGUÍA provides evidence-based recommendations for the management of adult patients with axSpA, focusing on pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions. The guideline addresses the use of biologic and targeted synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, prognostic factors for treatment response and radiographic progression, management of treatment failure, and strategies for treatment optimization, including dose tapering. Special attention is given to extra-musculoskeletal manifestations such as uveitis, inflammatory bowel disease, and psoriasis. Non-pharmacological approaches-including physical activity, smoking cessation, weight management, and nurse-led education-are emphasized as integral components of comprehensive care. ESPOGUÍA 2024 offers a comprehensive, evidence-based framework to support harmonized and patient-centered management of axSpA in Spain. By integrating recent therapeutic advances and multidisciplinary perspectives, the guideline aims to reduce variability in clinical practice, improve outcomes, and enhance quality of life for patients with axSpA, while also identifying key areas for future research.

items.titleZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎的治疗管理：2024年西班牙临床实践指南（ESPOGUIA）更新摘要
items.abstractZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）是一种慢性炎症性风湿病，与显著的发病率和生活质量受损相关。过去十年中，诊断、监测尤其是治疗方面的快速进展增加了axSpA管理的复杂性，并导致了临床实践的差异性。为满足这一需求，西班牙风湿病学会（SER）制定了其脊柱关节炎临床实践指南ESPOGUÍA的更新版本。本综述总结了更新后的建议。一个多学科专家组（包括风湿病学家、其他医学专家、护士、物理治疗师、方法学家和患者）使用PICO框架制定了关键临床问题。在主要数据库中进行了涵盖2018-2023年期间的系统文献综述。使用推荐分级评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法评估证据质量和推荐强度。当证据不足时，通过使用GRADE证据到决策框架的结构化审议共识过程制定建议。患者代表在整个过程中积极贡献，指南草案经过了公开咨询。ESPOGUÍA为成人axSpA患者的管理提供了基于证据的建议，重点关注药物和非药物干预。该指南涉及生物制剂和靶向合成改善病情抗风湿药的使用、治疗反应和影像学进展的预后因素、治疗失败的管理以及治疗优化策略（包括剂量递减）。特别关注关节外表现，如葡萄膜炎、炎症性肠病和银屑病。非药物方法——包括体育活动、戒烟、体重管理和护士主导的教育——被强调为综合护理的组成部分。ESPOGUÍA 2024提供了一个全面的、基于证据的框架，以支持西班牙axSpA的协调和以患者为中心的管理。通过整合近期治疗进展和多学科视角，该指南旨在减少临床实践中的差异性，改善结局，并提高axSpA患者的生活质量，同时确定未来研究的关键领域。

items.title: Recurrent uveitis unveiling axial spondyloarthritis: is inflammatory back pain always the main road to diagnosis? A monocentric cohort.
items.abstract: Nongranulomatous acute anterior uveitis (NG-AAU) is the most common extra-articular manifestation of spondyloarthritis (SpA) and may be a warning sign of previously undiagnosed axial SpA (ax-SpA). Given the known diagnostic delay of ax-SpA, this study aimed to determine the prevalence of previously undiagnosed ax-SpA among NG-AAU patients and to characterize the clinical features of ax-SpA identified through uveitis. Cross-sectional study. This monocentric study included consecutive NG-AAU patients referred to a tertiary ophthalmologic center between August 2024 and August 2025. All patients underwent a comprehensive rheumatologic assessment, including human leukocyte antigen B27 (HLA-B27) testing and sacro-iliac joint magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Ultrasound evaluation of entheses and symptomatic joints was also performed. SpA diagnosis was established by expert opinion based on clinical, laboratory, and imaging findings. Among 68 NG-AAU patients, 38 without a previous rheumatic diagnosis were included. Sixteen (43.2%) received a new diagnosis of ax-SpA, and none with peripheral SpA. HLA-B27 positivity was more frequent in ax-SpA than in non-SpA patients (56% vs 33%). All ax-SpA patients reported prior episodes of back pain, although inflammatory back pain was present in only 56.3% at the time of evaluation. Mean Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI) scores and symptom duration were significantly higher in ax-SpA patients ( p  = 0.005 and p  = 0.041, respectively). MRI revealed active sacroiliitis in 62.5% and erosions in 75% of newly diagnosed ax-SpA patients. Only 68.7% of new diagnoses fulfilled the 2009 Assessment of Spondyloarthritis International Society (ASAS) classification criteria for ax-SpA. Nearly half of NG-AAU patients had previously unrecognized ax-SpA, often presenting with mild or atypical axial symptoms. These findings highlight the importance of integrated ophthalmologic and rheumatologic evaluation to facilitate earlier ax-SpA diagnosis.

items.titleZh: 复发性葡萄膜炎揭示中轴型脊柱关节炎：炎性腰背痛是否总是诊断的主要途径？一项单中心队列研究。
items.abstractZh: 非肉芽肿性急性前葡萄膜炎（NG-AAU）是脊柱关节炎（SpA）最常见的关节外表现，可能是既往未诊断的中轴型脊柱关节炎（ax-SpA）的警示信号。鉴于ax-SpA已知的诊断延迟，本研究旨在确定NG-AAU患者中既往未诊断ax-SpA的患病率，并通过葡萄膜炎识别ax-SpA的临床特征。横断面研究。本单中心研究纳入了2024年8月至2025年8月期间转诊至三级眼科中心的连续NG-AAU患者。所有患者均接受了全面的风湿病学评估，包括人类白细胞抗原B27（HLA-B27）检测和骶髂关节磁共振成像（MRI）。同时进行了附着点及有症状关节的超声评估。SpA诊断由专家根据临床、实验室和影像学结果综合判断。在68例NG-AAU患者中，纳入38例无既往风湿病诊断者。16例（43.2%）新诊断为ax-SpA，无外周型SpA。HLA-B27阳性率在ax-SpA组高于非SpA组（56%对33%）。所有ax-SpA患者均报告既往有背痛发作，但评估时仅56.3%存在炎性腰背痛。ax-SpA患者的平均Bath强直性脊柱炎疾病活动指数（BASDAI）评分和症状持续时间显著更高（p=0.005和p=0.041）。MRI显示新诊断ax-SpA患者中62.5%有活动性骶髂关节炎，75%有侵蚀。仅68.7%的新诊断符合2009年国际脊柱关节炎协会（ASAS）ax-SpA分类标准。近半数NG-AAU患者存在既往未识别的ax-SpA，常表现为轻度或非典型轴向症状。这些发现强调了眼科与风湿病学综合评估对促进ax-SpA早期诊断的重要性。

items.title: Recurrent Multi-level Spinal Subdural Hematoma in Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis: A Therapeutic Dilemma Between Ischemia and Hemorrhage.
items.abstract: Spinal subdural hematoma (SSDH) associated with granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA) is extremely rare. A 63-year-old man with GPA and recurrent cerebral infarctions developed multi-level SSDHs while receiving immunotherapy and antithrombotic therapy. The hematomas were resolved conservatively, but they recurred in the posterior fossa and thoracic spine one year later. High cerebrospinal fluid interleukin-6 levels during ischemic events suggest active central nervous system vasculitis. This case illustrates a critical therapeutic dilemma: managing the competing risks of vasculitic ischemic stroke and hemorrhagic complications, such as SSDH. This case highlights the importance of balancing aggressive immunotherapy to suppress the vasculitis activity with cautious antithrombotic management.

items.titleZh: 肉芽肿性多血管炎中复发性多节段脊髓硬膜下血肿：缺血与出血之间的治疗困境。
items.abstractZh: 与肉芽肿性多血管炎（GPA）相关的脊髓硬膜下血肿（SSDH）极为罕见。一名患有GPA和复发性脑梗死的63岁男性在接受免疫治疗和抗血栓治疗期间出现了多节段SSDH。血肿经保守治疗后消退，但一年后在颅后窝和胸椎复发。缺血事件期间脑脊液白细胞介素-6水平升高提示活动性中枢神经系统血管炎。该病例说明了一个关键的治疗困境：管理血管炎性缺血性卒中与出血性并发症（如SSDH）之间的竞争风险。该病例强调了平衡积极免疫治疗以抑制血管炎活动与谨慎抗血栓管理的重要性。

items.title: Theranostic Nanoprobes for Rheumatoid Arthritis: From Inflammation Visualization to Guided Precision Therapy.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by persistent synovitis, progressive joint damage, and considerable heterogeneity in disease evolution and treatment response. The concept of theranostic nanoprobes has recently moved beyond multifunctional carriers that simply package imaging and therapeutic agents; instead, these platforms are being designed to establish an integrated imaging-therapy-feedback loop that enables disease-specific targeting, real-time molecular visualization, on-demand intervention, and dynamic monitoring of treatment effects-all within a single system. This review traces the evolution of RA theranostic nanoprobes along this trajectory, from molecular targeting and inflammation imaging, through therapeutic delivery and response monitoring, toward adaptive precision management. We first outline the pathological and biological features that enable selective homing to inflamed joints and subsequent molecular imaging of disease activity. We then survey current therapeutic strategies-including anti-inflammatory drug delivery, immunomodulation, redox regulation, and phototherapy-with an emphasis on how these modalities are being functionally coupled with imaging capabilities to support image-guided intervention and treatment feedback. Building on these advances, we propose a conceptual framework that distinguishes fully integrated theranostic platforms from conventional diagnostic nanoprobes and therapeutic nanocarriers. While preclinical progress has been substantial, clinical translation remains hindered by outstanding challenges in long-term safety, biodistribution, repeat-dose compatibility, manufacturing reproducibility, regulatory complexity, and validation against established clinical endpoints. Future advances will require not only improved nanoparticle design but also standardized translational evaluation and closer integration with clinically relevant disease-assessment strategies.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎诊疗纳米探针：从炎症可视化到引导精准治疗
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，其特征为持续性滑膜炎、进行性关节损伤以及疾病演变和治疗反应的高度异质性。诊疗纳米探针的概念最近已超越简单封装成像和治疗药物的多功能载体；相反，这些平台正被设计用于建立集成的成像-治疗-反馈回路，从而在单一系统内实现疾病特异性靶向、实时分子可视化、按需干预和治疗效果的动态监测。本综述沿着这一轨迹追溯了RA诊疗纳米探针的演变，从分子靶向和炎症成像，到治疗递送和反应监测，再到适应性精准管理。我们首先概述了能够选择性归巢至发炎关节并随后对疾病活动进行分子成像的病理学和生物学特征。然后，我们综述了当前的治疗策略——包括抗炎药物递送、免疫调节、氧化还原调节和光疗——并重点介绍了这些方式如何与成像能力功能性耦合，以支持图像引导干预和治疗反馈。基于这些进展，我们提出了一个概念框架，将完全集成的诊疗平台与传统诊断纳米探针和治疗纳米载体区分开来。尽管临床前进展显著，但临床转化仍受到长期安全性、生物分布、重复给药相容性、制造可重复性、监管复杂性以及针对既定临床终点的验证等突出挑战的阻碍。未来的进展不仅需要改进纳米颗粒设计，还需要标准化的转化评估以及与临床相关疾病评估策略的更紧密整合。

items.title: Lung cancer risk in systemic sclerosis: data from an inception cohort and meta-analysis of published studies.
items.abstract: Population-based cohort studies show an association between systemic sclerosis (SSc) and lung cancer; however, a Mendelian randomisation analysis refutes causality. Herein, lung cancer risk is analysed in an academic inception SSc cohort, complemented by a meta-analysis of published data. Patients evaluated within 12 months of SSc onset, between January 1995 and December 2020, with regular follow-up until December 2024, were included. Clinical manifestations, laboratory parameters, treatments and comorbidities were prospectively recorded. Age-standardised incidence ratio (SIR) of lung cancer was estimated using the Global Cancer Observatory database. Lung cancer determinants were evaluated with Cox proportional hazards models. A systematic literature search for the association between SSc and cancer and a meta-analysis of lung cancer SIRs from eligible studies was conducted. Among 180 patients (2,110 person-years follow-up), lung cancer was diagnosed in 12, after a mean 10.2±5.9 years from SSc onset. Age-SIR was 5.1 (95% CI 4.7-5.4) for the entire cohort, 3.8 (95% CI 3.5-4.1) for male and 9.5 (95% CI 8.7-10.3) for female patients. Diffuse subtype [HR = 4.22, 95% CI: 1.03-17.35] and smoking history [HR = 4.49, 95% CI: 1.14-17.69] were associated with lung cancer development, whereas digital ulcers were inversely associated [HR: 0.13, 95% CI: 0.03-0.63]. The meta-analysis of 17 studies (27,563 SSc patients) yielded a pooled lung cancer age-SIR of 3.85 [95% CI (2.63-5.63)]. Long-term follow-up data from an SSc inception cohort indicate a fivefold increased lung cancer risk in SSc, nearly doubled among female patients. Further studies are warranted to inform screening strategies.

items.titleZh: 系统性硬化症中的肺癌风险：来自初始队列的数据及已发表研究的荟萃分析
items.abstractZh: 基于人群的队列研究显示系统性硬化症（SSc）与肺癌之间存在关联；然而，孟德尔随机化分析否定了因果关系。本文在一个学术性初始SSc队列中分析了肺癌风险，并辅以已发表数据的荟萃分析。纳入1995年1月至2020年12月期间在SSc发病后12个月内接受评估、并定期随访至2024年12月的患者。前瞻性记录临床表现、实验室参数、治疗和合并症。使用全球癌症观察站数据库估算肺癌的年龄标准化发病率比（SIR）。采用Cox比例风险模型评估肺癌的决定因素。进行了关于SSc与癌症关联的系统文献检索，并对符合条件研究的肺癌SIR进行了荟萃分析。在180名患者（2110人年随访）中，12名患者在SSc发病后平均10.2±5.9年被诊断为肺癌。整个队列的年龄SIR为5.1（95% CI 4.7-5.4），男性为3.8（95% CI 3.5-4.1），女性为9.5（95% CI 8.7-10.3）。弥漫性亚型[HR = 4.22, 95% CI: 1.03-17.35]和吸烟史[HR = 4.49, 95% CI: 1.14-17.69]与肺癌发生相关，而指端溃疡呈负相关[HR: 0.13, 95% CI: 0.03-0.63]。对17项研究（27,563名SSc患者）的荟萃分析得出合并肺癌年龄SIR为3.85 [95% CI (2.63-5.63)]。来自SSc初始队列的长期随访数据表明，SSc患者肺癌风险增加五倍，女性患者中几乎翻倍。需要进一步研究以指导筛查策略。

items.title: Emotional unawareness in psoriatic arthritis: decoding the impact of alexithymia on pain perception, disease activity, and treatment response.
items.abstract: Psychological distress influences pain and disease severity perception among patients affected by psoriatic arthritis (PsA). Alexithymia, a personal trait characterised by the difficulty in recognising and articulating emotions, has been observed in other rheumatic diseases, but its role in PsA remains underrecognised. We investigated the prevalence of alexithymia in PsA and its association with disease activity, psychological burden, and treatment complexity. A cross-sectional observational study was conducted across three Italian rheumatology centers, enrolling PsA patients on stable biological therapy. Toronto Alexithymia Scale (TAS-20), Pain Catastrophising Scale (PCS), Beck's Depression Inventory (BDI), Widespread Pain Index (WPI), Symptom Severity Scale (SSS), alongside Disease Activity Index for PsA (DAPSA), Bath Axial Spondyloarthritis Disease Activity Index (BASDAI), and Axial Spondyloarthritis Disease Activity Index-C Reactive Protein (ASDAS-CRP) were assessed at last follow-up. Associations with alexithymia were explored by univariate analyses, Spearman correlation, and multivariable logistic regression. Among 207 PsA patients, 63 (30.4%) were classified as alexithymic (TAS≥61). Patients with alexithymia exhibited significantly higher pain-VAS, patient and physician global assessment, tender joint count, PCS, WPI+SSS, and BDI scores, as well as elevated DAPSA, BASDAI, ASDAS-CRP, while inflammatory markers and swollen joint count were similar between groups. Alexithymic patients underwent multiple biological therapy lines and reported increased conventional synthetic DMARDs and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug usage. A strong correlation emerged between TAS-20 and PCS, alongside female sex, concomitant fibromyalgia and higher DAPSA were independent predictors of alexithymia in multivariable model. Alexithymia is present in PsA and is linked to increased pain perception, disease activity and treatment burden.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎中的情绪觉察缺失：解码述情障碍对疼痛感知、疾病活动度和治疗反应的影响
items.abstractZh: 心理困扰影响银屑病关节炎（PsA）患者的疼痛和疾病严重程度感知。述情障碍是一种以难以识别和表达情绪为特征的个人特质，已在其他风湿性疾病中观察到，但其在PsA中的作用仍未得到充分认识。我们调查了PsA中述情障碍的患病率及其与疾病活动度、心理负担和治疗复杂性的关联。在意大利三个风湿病中心进行了一项横断面观察性研究，纳入接受稳定生物制剂治疗的PsA患者。在最后一次随访时评估了多伦多述情障碍量表（TAS-20）、疼痛灾难化量表（PCS）、贝克抑郁量表（BDI）、广泛性疼痛指数（WPI）、症状严重程度量表（SSS），以及PsA疾病活动指数（DAPSA）、Bath中轴型脊柱关节炎疾病活动指数（BASDAI）和中轴型脊柱关节炎疾病活动指数-C反应蛋白（ASDAS-CRP）。通过单变量分析、Spearman相关性和多变量逻辑回归探讨了与述情障碍的关联。在207名PsA患者中，63名（30.4%）被归类为述情障碍（TAS≥61）。述情障碍患者表现出显著更高的疼痛视觉模拟评分（pain-VAS）、患者和医生总体评估、压痛关节计数、PCS、WPI+SSS和BDI评分，以及升高的DAPSA、BASDAI、ASDAS-CRP，而炎症标志物和肿胀关节计数在两组间相似。述情障碍患者接受了多种生物制剂治疗线，并报告了更多的传统合成改善病情抗风湿药（DMARDs）和非甾体抗炎药使用。TAS-20与PCS之间出现强相关性，同时女性、合并纤维肌痛和较高的DAPSA在多变量模型中是述情障碍的独立预测因子。述情障碍存在于PsA中，并与疼痛感知增加、疾病活动度和治疗负担相关。

items.title: Clinical distinctions of anti-topoisomerase positive limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis in early disease: results from the early Systemic sclerOsis Longitudinal Assessment Registry from Turkey.
items.abstract: Anti-topoisomerase I antibody (ATA) is typically associated with diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis (dcSSc). However, subset of limited cutaneous SSc (lcSSc) patients also present with ATA positivity. Emerging data suggest that ATA-positive lcSSc may represent a distinct or intermediate clinical phenotype. This study aimed to compare the demographic, clinical, and treatment features of early ATA-positive lcSSc patients with those of ACA-positive lcSSc and ATA-positive dcSSc patients. Patients were recruited from the multicentre Turkish SOLAR cohort (Systemic sclerOsis Longitudinal Assessment Registry). Among 295 SSc patients screened, 172 were included: 74 ACA-positive lcSSc, 55 ATA-positive lcSSc, and 43 ATA-positive dcSSc. Demographic, clinical, and treatment-related variables were analysed and compared across groups. ATA-positive lcSSc patients were younger at the onset of Raynaud's phenomenon (RP) (p=0.042), the first non-RP symptom (p=0.016), and at diagnosis (p=0.018) compared with ACA-positive lcSSc patients. Interstitial lung disease (ILD) was significantly more frequent in ATA-positive lcSSc (74.5%) than ACA-positive lcSSc (8.1%, p<0.001) and was comparable to ATA-positive dcSSc. Modified Rodnan skin scores were highest in ATA-positive dcSSc but were also significantly elevated in ATA-positive lcSSc (p<0.001). Pitting scars were more frequent in dcSSc. Among patients with ILD, ATA-positive lcSSc and ATA-positive dcSSc showed similar HRCT patterns. ATA-positive lcSSc patients were more frequently treated with glucocorticoids and mycophenolate mofetil than ACA-positive lcSSc, whereas cyclophosphamide was highest in dcSSc. ATA-positive lcSSc patients exhibit a clinically distinct phenotype characterized by a substantial risk of internal organ involvement, despite having less extensive skin disease. Their overlap with dcSSc and divergence from ACA-positive lcSSc highlight the importance of incorporating both skin involvement and serologic subtyping into the early management and risk stratification of SSc.

items.title: Outcome and risk factors for progression in IgG4-related disease under watchful waiting.
items.abstract: This study aimed to explore the risk factors for progression in immunoglobulin G4-related disease (IgG4-RD) under watchful waiting and the temporal distribution of progression events to inform clinical decision-making. A total of 40 IgG4-RD patients managed with the watchful waiting strategy were identified and included. Patients were categorised into 'without internal organ involvement' (WOI, n=26) and 'with internal organ involvement' (WI, n=14) groups. Baseline characteristics and progression rates were compared. Risk factors for progression were further identified using logistic and Cox regression analyses in the WOI group. The distribution of time to disease progression was summarised. Progression occurred in 12/40 patients (5 in WOI vs. 7 in WI). Kaplan-Meier analysis showed a significantly higher stability probability in the WOI group (p=0.048). Paranasal sinus involvement, high response index (RI), elevated eosinophil percentage (Eos%), and high IgE levels were significant risk factors for progression in WOI group. Notably, all progression events occurred within the first year of follow-up, with the estimated hazard function peaking at 6 to 8 months and declining thereafter. IgG4-RD patients with internal organ involvement exhibit a higher rate of disease progression under watchful waiting. Paranasal sinus involvement, high RI, high Eos%, and high IgE levels were identified as potential risk factors for disease progression. Intensive surveillance is especially warranted during the early phase.

items.titleZh: 观察等待下IgG4相关疾病进展的结局及危险因素
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨在观察等待策略下免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病（IgG4-RD）进展的危险因素及进展事件的时间分布，以指导临床决策。共纳入并识别了40例采用观察等待策略管理的IgG4-RD患者。患者被分为“无内脏器官受累”组（WOI，n=26）和“有内脏器官受累”组（WI，n=14）。比较了基线特征和进展率。在WOI组中，进一步使用logistic和Cox回归分析确定了进展的危险因素。总结了疾病进展时间的分布。12/40例患者发生进展（WOI组5例 vs. WI组7例）。Kaplan-Meier分析显示WOI组的稳定性概率显著更高（p=0.048）。鼻旁窦受累、高反应指数（RI）、嗜酸性粒细胞百分比（Eos%）升高和高IgE水平是WOI组进展的显著危险因素。值得注意的是，所有进展事件均发生在随访的第一年内，估计的风险函数在6至8个月达到峰值，此后下降。有内脏器官受累的IgG4-RD患者在观察等待下表现出更高的疾病进展率。鼻旁窦受累、高RI、高Eos%和高IgE水平被确定为疾病进展的潜在危险因素。在早期阶段尤其需要加强监测。

items.title: Complement Component 4D (C4d) Staining in Lupus Nephritis: Correlating Renal Histopathological Features With Clinical Presentation and Short-Term Outcomes.
items.abstract: Introduction Systemic lupus erythematosus frequently manifests as lupus nephritis (LN), a major cause of renal morbidity. Standard markers lack specificity, making renal biopsy essential. Complement component 4D (C4d) staining, reflecting classical complement activation, correlates with histopathological lesions and outcomes. This study evaluates C4d's clinical relevance in biopsy-proven LN, emphasizing its potential in detecting disease severity. Materials & methods This observational study at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University (BSMMU), Dhaka, conducted from September 2021 to August 2022, enrolled 45 adults with biopsy-proven LN; 43 completed follow-up. Participants were selected based on revised American College of Rheumatology (ACR) criteria and underwent thorough clinical evaluation, serological testing, and ultrasound-guided renal biopsy. Histopathological assessment followed the International Society of Nephrology and the Renal Pathology Society (ISN/RPS) 2003 classification, including activity and chronicity indices and immunohistochemical C4d staining. Follow-up investigations were performed at two and six months. Results Among the 43 patients with LN (mean age 28.4 ± 7.7 years; 86% female subjects), 42 (97.7%) patients had hematuria and 25 (58.1%) had renal impairment. Class IV was the predominant histological subtype in 18 (41.9%) cases, with mild chronicity in 20 (71.4%) cases. C4d deposition, primarily arteriolar in 24 (55.8%) cases, correlated significantly with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Disease Activity Index (SLEDAI) scores and histological activity indices (p<0.05). There is a significant relationship between C4d intensity and SLEDAI score, highlighting the prognostic utility of C4d staining. Conclusion The present study identifies C4d staining to be associated with active renal damage and higher SLEDAI scores, reflecting immune-mediated injury. These findings highlight its value as a potential marker that may enhance current histological assessment. Therefore, staining with C4d on renal biopsy may be emphasized for early detection of severity in patients with lupus.

items.titleZh: 补体成分4D（C4d）染色在狼疮性肾炎中的应用：肾组织病理学特征与临床表现及短期结局的相关性
items.abstractZh: 引言 系统性红斑狼疮常表现为狼疮性肾炎（LN），是肾脏发病的主要原因。标准标志物缺乏特异性，使得肾活检至关重要。补体成分4D（C4d）染色反映经典补体激活，与组织病理学病变和结局相关。本研究评估C4d在活检证实的LN中的临床相关性，强调其在检测疾病严重程度方面的潜力。材料与方法 这项在达卡Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib医科大学（BSMMU）进行的观察性研究，时间从2021年9月至2022年8月，纳入了45名经活检证实的LN成人患者；43人完成了随访。参与者根据修订的美国风湿病学会（ACR）标准入选，并接受了全面的临床评估、血清学检测和超声引导下肾活检。组织病理学评估遵循国际肾脏病学会和肾脏病理学会（ISN/RPS）2003年分类，包括活动性和慢性化指数以及免疫组织化学C4d染色。随访检查在第二个月和第六个月进行。结果 在43名LN患者中（平均年龄28.4±7.7岁；86%为女性），42名（97.7%）患者有血尿，25名（58.1%）有肾功能损害。IV型是主要组织学亚型，见于18例（41.9%），其中20例（71.4%）为轻度慢性化。C4d沉积主要见于小动脉，共24例（55.8%），与系统性红斑狼疮疾病活动指数（SLEDAI）评分和组织学活动指数显著相关（p<0.05）。C4d强度与SLEDAI评分之间存在显著关系，凸显了C4d染色的预后价值。结论 本研究确定C4d染色与活动性肾损伤和较高的SLEDAI评分相关，反映了免疫介导的损伤。这些发现强调了其作为潜在标志物的价值，可能增强当前的组织学评估。因此，肾活检中的C4d染色可能有助于早期检测狼疮患者的疾病严重程度。

items.title: When Gastroenteritis Struck the Brain: Post-infectious Parkinsonism Suggestive of Neuropsychiatric Systemic Lupus Erythematosus in a Patient With Aqueductal Stenosis.
items.abstract: Parkinsonism is a rare neuropsychiatric manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), the pathogenesis of which has been proposed to involve immune-mediated vasculopathy. Gastrointestinal infections may exacerbate autoimmune responses, triggering disease flares. We present a 26-year-old woman who developed acute parkinsonism with mutism, oromandibular dystonia, and horizontal square wave jerks following a diarrheal illness. Neurological examination revealed cogwheel rigidity and dysphagia. Brain MRI showed periventricular hyperintensities, ventricular dilation, and aqueductal stenosis without basal ganglia infarcts or lesions. Antinuclear antibody was positive (1:100) with anti-SS-A and anti-SS-B antibodies, while complement levels remained within normal limits. Treatment with pulsed methylprednisolone, rituximab, hydroxychloroquine, and levodopa-carbidopa resulted in marked neurological improvement. The patient did not fulfill the 2019 European League Against Rheumatism/American College of Rheumatology classification criteria for SLE; however, the clinical features and robust therapeutic response were consistent with a presumptive diagnosis of neuropsychiatric SLE presenting as parkinsonism. This case underscores the importance of considering SLE in young patients with atypical parkinsonism, particularly following a gastrointestinal illness. It highlights that complement levels may not reliably reflect disease activity in all patients.

items.titleZh: 当胃肠炎侵袭大脑：一例导水管狭窄患者出现感染后帕金森综合征，提示神经精神性系统性红斑狼疮
items.abstractZh: 帕金森综合征是系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）罕见的神经精神表现，其发病机制被认为涉及免疫介导的血管病变。胃肠道感染可能加剧自身免疫反应，触发疾病发作。我们报告一例26岁女性，在腹泻性疾病后出现急性帕金森综合征，伴有缄默症、口下颌肌张力障碍和水平方波跳动。神经系统检查显示齿轮样强直和吞咽困难。脑MRI显示脑室周围高信号、脑室扩张和导水管狭窄，无基底节梗死或病变。抗核抗体阳性（1:100），抗SS-A和抗SS-B抗体阳性，而补体水平保持在正常范围内。脉冲甲泼尼龙、利妥昔单抗、羟氯喹和左旋多巴-卡比多巴治疗后，神经系统显著改善。该患者不符合2019年欧洲抗风湿病联盟/美国风湿病学会SLE分类标准；然而，临床特征和显著的治疗反应与推定诊断为表现为帕金森综合征的神经精神性SLE一致。本病例强调了在年轻非典型帕金森综合征患者中考虑SLE的重要性，尤其是在胃肠道疾病之后。它强调补体水平可能不能可靠地反映所有患者的疾病活动性。

items.title: Barriers to Timely Rheumatologic Care for Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Real-World Questionnaire-based Study from Karnataka Chapter of Indian Rheumatology Association (KRA).
items.abstract: To assess referral timelines to rheumatologists in Karnataka, India, identify factors linked to delays, and to examine their impact on disease activity, functional disability, and economic burden. A multicenter, cross-sectional, observational questionnaire-based study was conducted across 17 rheumatology centers in Karnataka, India (June, 2023-July, 2024). Disease activity (DAS28, CDAI), disability (HAQ-DI), and healthcare expenditure prior to referral and during the past 1 year were analyzed in relation to self-reported referral time, categorized as early (≤3 months from symptom onset) and late (>24 months). Utilization of healthcare schemes available in Karnataka was captured. Among 2,141 participants with RA, the median referral time to a rheumatologist was 18 (6-36) months, early referral (≤3 months) in 17% ( n = 365), and late referral (>24 months) in 31% ( n = 662). Older age [AOR = 1.01 (1.005-1.02)], being married [AOR = 1.48 (1.03-2.12)], resident of non-Bengaluru regions [AOR = 2.26 (1.60-3.19)], academic treating facility [AOR = 2.32 (1.68-3.18)], and longer duration of illness >120 months [AOR =2.84 (2.14-3.76)] had higher odds of late referrals. This group had significantly higher expenditure prior to referral [β = 3.57 (3.05-4.19)], higher total annual medical expenditure [β = 1.20 (1.09-1.32)], and catastrophic expenditure [β = 1.56 (1.22-2.01)]. 52 % ( n = 1120) of participants reported out-of-pocket healthcare expenditure. Delayed referral to a rheumatologist was associated with increased disability and financial strain, including a significantly higher risk of catastrophic health expenditure.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎及时风湿病学诊疗的障碍：来自印度风湿病学协会卡纳塔克邦分会（KRA）的一项基于问卷的真实世界研究
items.abstractZh: 评估印度卡纳塔克邦转诊至风湿病学家的时间线，识别与延迟相关的因素，并检查其对疾病活动性、功能残疾和经济负担的影响。在印度卡纳塔克邦的17个风湿病学中心进行了一项多中心、横断面、观察性问卷研究（2023年6月至2024年7月）。分析了转诊前及过去1年内的疾病活动性（DAS28、CDAI）、残疾（HAQ-DI）和医疗支出，并与自我报告的转诊时间相关联，转诊时间分为早期（症状出现后≤3个月）和晚期（>24个月）。记录了卡纳塔克邦可用医疗保健计划的使用情况。在2,141名RA参与者中，转诊至风湿病学家的中位时间为18（6-36）个月，早期转诊（≤3个月）占17%（n=365），晚期转诊（>24个月）占31%（n=662）。年龄较大[AOR=1.01（1.005-1.02）]、已婚[AOR=1.48（1.03-2.12）]、非班加罗尔地区居民[AOR=2.26（1.60-3.19）]、学术治疗机构[AOR=2.32（1.68-3.18）]以及病程>120个月[AOR=2.84（2.14-3.76）]的晚期转诊几率较高。该组在转诊前支出显著更高[β=3.57（3.05-4.19）]，年度总医疗支出更高[β=1.20（1.09-1.32）]，灾难性支出更高[β=1.56（1.22-2.01）]。52%（n=1120）的参与者报告了自付医疗支出。延迟转诊至风湿病学家与残疾增加和经济负担加重相关，包括灾难性医疗支出风险显著升高。

items.title: A Complex Case of Systemic Sclerosis with Concurrent Breast Malignancy and Treatment-related Complications.
items.abstract: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is a complex autoimmune disease marked by vasculopathy, fibrosis, and multisystem involvement. Interstitial lung disease (ILD) and pulmonary hypertension (PH) are major mortality contributors. Importantly, SSc is associated with an increased risk of malignancy. This report presents a challenging case of SSc with severe Raynaud's phenomenon (RP), digital gangrene, calcinosis cutis, extensive ILD, severe PH, and right heart failure. The patient underwent mesenchymal stem cell therapy (MST), following which she developed breast cancer and chemotherapy-related complications, ultimately leading to death. This case highlights the need for timely intervention, screening for malignancy, and awareness of potential therapy-related risks in SSc.
